```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fixest)
library(modelsummary)
library(knitr)
library(MatchIt)
library(cobalt)

set.seed(123)
```

```{r load-data}
df <- fread("Insurance.csv")

df <- df %>%
  select(YEAR, STATEFIP, MET2013, SEX, AGE, RACE, RACED, HCOVANY) %>%
  filter(
    YEAR %in% c(2013, 2014, 2015),
    STATEFIP %in% c(6, 48),
    AGE >= 19,
    AGE <= 64
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    state = case_when(
      STATEFIP == 6 ~ "California",
      STATEFIP == 48 ~ "Texas"
    ),
    expansion = ifelse(STATEFIP == 6, 1, 0),
    insured = ifelse(HCOVANY == 2, 1,
                     ifelse(HCOVANY == 1, 0, NA)),
    female = ifelse(SEX == 2, 1, 0),
    metro = ifelse(MET2013 > 0, 1, 0),
    metro_f = factor(metro, levels = c(0, 1),
                     labels = c("Non-metro", "Metro")),
    race_f = factor(RACE)
  )
```

```{r main-analysis-sample}
main_df <- df %>%
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2013, 2015)) %>%
  mutate(
    post = ifelse(YEAR == 2015, 1, 0),
    period = ifelse(YEAR == 2013, "Pre (2013)", "Post (2015)"),
    group = paste(state, period)
  )
```

```{r summary-statistics}
mean_sd <- function(x) {
  paste0(
    round(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    " (",
    round(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    ")"
  )
}

table1 <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("Insured", "Age", "Female", "Metro", "Observations"),

  "California Pre (2013)" = c(
    mean_sd(main_df$insured[main_df$group == "California Pre (2013)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$AGE[main_df$group == "California Pre (2013)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$female[main_df$group == "California Pre (2013)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$metro[main_df$group == "California Pre (2013)"]),
    sum(main_df$group == "California Pre (2013)")
  ),

  "California Post (2015)" = c(
    mean_sd(main_df$insured[main_df$group == "California Post (2015)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$AGE[main_df$group == "California Post (2015)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$female[main_df$group == "California Post (2015)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$metro[main_df$group == "California Post (2015)"]),
    sum(main_df$group == "California Post (2015)")
  ),

  "Texas Pre (2013)" = c(
    mean_sd(main_df$insured[main_df$group == "Texas Pre (2013)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$AGE[main_df$group == "Texas Pre (2013)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$female[main_df$group == "Texas Pre (2013)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$metro[main_df$group == "Texas Pre (2013)"]),
    sum(main_df$group == "Texas Pre (2013)")
  ),

  "Texas Post (2015)" = c(
    mean_sd(main_df$insured[main_df$group == "Texas Post (2015)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$AGE[main_df$group == "Texas Post (2015)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$female[main_df$group == "Texas Post (2015)"]),
    mean_sd(main_df$metro[main_df$group == "Texas Post (2015)"]),
    sum(main_df$group == "Texas Post (2015)")
  ),

  check.names = FALSE
)

kable(table1, caption = "Summary Statistics")

write.csv(table1, "table1_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r did-means}
did_means <- main_df %>%
  group_by(state, YEAR) %>%
  summarise(
    insured_rate = mean(insured, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

kable(did_means, caption = "Insurance Coverage Rates by State and Year")
```

```{r coverage-plot}
p1 <- ggplot(did_means,
             aes(x = YEAR,
                 y = insured_rate,
                 color = state,
                 group = state)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2013, 2015)) +
  labs(
    title = "Insurance Coverage Rates in California and Texas",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Insured Rate",
    color = "State"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p1

ggsave("coverage_trend_ca_tx.png", p1, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r main-did-model}
did_model <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post + AGE + female + race_f,
  data = main_df,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

summary(did_model)
```

```{r heterogeneity-model}
hetero_model <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post * metro + AGE + female + race_f,
  data = main_df,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

summary(hetero_model)
```

```{r subgroup-models}
did_metro <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post + AGE + female + race_f,
  data = main_df %>% filter(metro == 1),
  vcov = "hetero"
)

did_nonmetro <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post + AGE + female + race_f,
  data = main_df %>% filter(metro == 0),
  vcov = "hetero"
)

summary(did_metro)
summary(did_nonmetro)
```

```{r metro-plot}
interaction_plot <- main_df %>%
  group_by(state, YEAR, metro) %>%
  summarise(
    insured_rate = mean(insured, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    metro_status = ifelse(metro == 1, "Metro", "Non-metro"),
    group_label = paste(state, metro_status, sep = " - ")
  )

p2 <- ggplot(interaction_plot,
             aes(x = YEAR,
                 y = insured_rate,
                 color = state,
                 linetype = metro_status,
                 group = group_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2013, 2015)) +
  labs(
    title = "Medicaid Expansion Effects by Metro Status",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Insured Rate",
    color = "State",
    linetype = "Metro Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p2

ggsave("metro_vs_nonmetro.png", p2, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r robustness-2014-post}
robust_df <- df %>%
  filter(YEAR %in% c(2013, 2014, 2015)) %>%
  mutate(post = ifelse(YEAR >= 2014, 1, 0))

did_model_postall <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post + AGE + female + race_f + factor(YEAR),
  data = robust_df,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

hetero_model_postall <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post * metro + AGE + female + race_f + factor(YEAR),
  data = robust_df,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

summary(did_model_postall)
summary(hetero_model_postall)
```

```{r matching-robustness}
psm_df <- main_df %>%
  select(insured, expansion, post, YEAR, AGE, female, race_f, metro)

m_out <- matchit(
  expansion ~ AGE + female + race_f + metro,
  data = psm_df,
  method = "nearest",
  distance = "logit",
  exact = ~ YEAR
)

summary(m_out)

matched_df <- match.data(m_out)

did_model_matched <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post + AGE + female + race_f,
  data = matched_df,
  weights = ~ weights,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

hetero_model_matched <- feols(
  insured ~ expansion * post * metro + AGE + female + race_f,
  data = matched_df,
  weights = ~ weights,
  vcov = "hetero"
)

summary(did_model_matched)
summary(hetero_model_matched)
```

```{r regression-table}
modelsummary(
  list(
    "Main DiD" = did_model,
    "DiD x Metro" = hetero_model,
    "Matched DiD" = did_model_matched
  ),
  stars = TRUE,
  gof_omit = "AIC|BIC|Log.Lik|RMSE",
  output = "markdown"
)
```
